Name: Solo Four Corners Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/u7OHXN8.png[/img]

[list]
[*]replaces the vanilla four corners farm
[*]pre-built indestructible fences ([b]optional[/b])
[*]improved farm cave with link to farm quarry ([b]optional[/b])
[*]troughs act as a water source to refill watering can
[*]invisible barriers in pens to keep animals in
[*]works with stardew valley expanded
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S0qNRLv.png[/img]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=http://]C[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]ontent Patcher[/url]﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9jaJhmR.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]download and install the required mods
[*]download this mod and extract the folder inside the .zip to Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]run the game with SMAPI and start a new save on the Four Corners map

[/list]

[b][u]config.json options[/u][/b]
[i](run the game once with the mod installed to generate the file in the solo four corners mod folder)[/i]

"RemoveFences": "true" or "false" (default false)
"FarmCaveEnabled": "true" or "false" (default true)
